Scriberman 1.0.7

What’s new

  • Copy individual passages from live or finished transcripts, with timestamps now shown during recording.
  • Open full transcripts more easily with a dedicated “Read full transcript” button.
  • Manage tags in a dedicated Settings tab, opened directly by “Add new tag”.

Fixes

  • Speakers now have distinct colors, including in existing transcripts.
  • Live transcripts use one scrolling area and pause automatic scrolling while you read or select text.
  • Session rows no longer slide behind the search field, and Escape reliably clears the search.
  • Tag labels remain readable on both selected and unselected session rows.
